title: Best AI App Builder for Marketplace Builders in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI app builders on the five backend pieces every two-sided marketplace needs, and on the one thing most comparison articles never test for: help getting past the liquidity problem that kills 70% of marketplaces.
body_markdown: Sharetribe is a genuine, purpose-built marketplace platform and matches or edges out general-purpose builders on native marketplace plumbing: two-sided roles, Stripe Connect, listings, and search. Where it falls behind is cost, code ownership, and the liquidity problem specifically, it's a proprietary no-code runtime with no code export, and like other no-code marketplace platforms, migrating away from it once a founder needs custom transaction logic is documented to take 2 to 4 months.
